title: Minecraft 26.3 Snapshot 10

blocks.source_text: We've safely made it to 26.3 Snapshot 10! This week, the Dappled Forest panorama has made its way to the main menu, bringing cozy fall vibes every time you launch the game. This snapshot also includes a variety of technical changes and improvements, so dig in!
blocks.translated_text: 我们成功更新到了26.3 Snapshot 10！这周，斑驳森林（Dappled Forest）的全景图被添加到了主菜单中，每次启动游戏都能感受到惬意的秋日氛围。此次更新还包含了许多技术上的改进和优化，快来看看吧！

blocks.source_text: Happy mining!
blocks.translated_text: 祝你采矿愉快！

blocks.source_text: New Features
blocks.translated_text: 新功能

blocks.source_text: Realms
blocks.translated_text: Realms（游戏模式）

blocks.source_text: Added a new Realms introduction screen showcasing Realms key features
blocks.translated_text: 新增了一个介绍Realms主要功能的界面

blocks.source_text: Accessible from the "Add Realm" button
blocks.translated_text: 可以通过“添加Realms”按钮进入该模式

blocks.source_text: Automatically shown when entering Realms if a trial is available
blocks.translated_text: 如果支持试用版，进入Realms时会自动显示相关信息

blocks.source_text: Changes
blocks.translated_text: 变更

blocks.source_text: The Main Menu now has an updated background panorama showing the new Dappled Forest biome with an Abandoned Camp
blocks.translated_text: 主菜单的背景全景图现已更新为新的斑驳森林生物群系，并包含一个废弃营地

blocks.source_text: Changed the Adventure Mode icon in the Game Mode Switcher to the Buried Treasure Map
blocks.translated_text: 将游戏模式切换器中的冒险模式图标更改为埋藏宝藏地图

blocks.source_text: Improvements to performance when trying to locate structures
blocks.translated_text: 提升在寻找结构时的性能

blocks.source_text: Reverted recent changes to Drowned behavior and animations from this release cycle
blocks.translated_text: 恢复了本发布周期中对“淹没”生物（Drowned）的行为和动画的修改

blocks.source_text: Minor Tweaks to Blocks, Items and Entities
blocks.translated_text: 对方块、物品和实体进行了少量调整

blocks.source_text: Enchantments now apply to items being damaged from protecting an Undead mob from the sun
blocks.translated_text: 现在，保护亡灵生物免受阳光伤害时，附魔也会作用于被损坏的物品

blocks.source_text: Teleporting randomly after eating a Chorus Fruit now shows particles into the direction of the teleportation
blocks.translated_text: 食用“紫颂果实”（Chorus Fruit）后随机传送时，会显示指向传送方向的粒子效果

blocks.source_text: Explorer Maps
blocks.translated_text: 探险者地图（Explorer Maps）

blocks.source_text: The following Explorer Maps have been renamed to have more consistent naming
blocks.translated_text: 以下探险者地图已重新命名，以便命名更加统一

blocks.source_text: Ocean Monument Explore Map -> Ocean Monument Map
blocks.translated_text: “海洋纪念碑探索地图”（Ocean Monument Explore Map）更名为“海洋纪念碑地图”（Ocean Monument Map）

blocks.source_text: Swamp Hut Explorer Map -> Swamp Hut Map
blocks.translated_text: “沼泽小屋探索地图”（Swamp Hut Explorer Map）更名为“沼泽小屋地图”（Swamp Hut Map）

blocks.source_text: Trial Chambers Explorer Map -> Buried Trial Chambers Map
blocks.translated_text: “试炼密室探索地图”（Trial Chambers Explorer Map）更名为“埋藏的试炼密室地图”（Buried Trial Chambers Map）

blocks.source_text: Woodland Mansion Explorer Map -> Woodland Mansion Map
blocks.translated_text: “Woodland Mansion Explorer Map” -> “Woodland Mansion Map”

blocks.source_text: Jungle Pyramid Explorer Map -> Jungle Pyramid Map
blocks.translated_text: “Jungle Pyramid Explorer Map” -> “Jungle Pyramid Map”

blocks.source_text: Accessibility
blocks.translated_text: “无障碍功能（Accessibility）”

blocks.source_text: Subtitles now point to the most recent sound in range
blocks.translated_text: 字幕现在会指向范围内的最新音效

blocks.source_text: Technical Changes
blocks.translated_text: “技术性变更”

blocks.source_text: The Data Pack version is now 118.0
blocks.translated_text: 数据包的版本现在是 118.0

blocks.source_text: The Resource Pack version is now 97.0
blocks.translated_text: 资源包的版本现在是 97.0

blocks.source_text: The none swing animation type has been readded
blocks.translated_text: 重新添加了“无摆动动画类型（none swing animation type）”

blocks.source_text: This affects the /swing command as well as the minecraft:attack_animation and minecraft:interact_animation components
blocks.translated_text: 这会影响「/swing」命令，以及「minecraft:attack_animation」と「minecraft:interact_animation」组件

blocks.source_text: Data Pack Version 118
blocks.translated_text: 数据包版本 118

blocks.source_text: Commands
blocks.translated_text: 命令

blocks.source_text: Added compute
blocks.translated_text: 新增了 compute 命令

blocks.source_text: Evaluates minecraft:number_provider in various contexts
blocks.translated_text: 在各种上下文中评估 minecraft:number_provider

blocks.source_text: In all contexts origin is set to current command context position, while this entity is set to @s
blocks.translated_text: 在所有上下文中，origin 被设置为当前命令上下文的位置，而这个实体被设置为 @s

blocks.source_text: Syntax:
blocks.translated_text: 语法：

blocks.source_text: /compute <target> <provider> [<scale>|integer] , where:
blocks.translated_text: /compute <目标> <提供者> [<缩放>|整数] ，其中：

blocks.source_text: <target> - one of:
blocks.translated_text: <目标> - 可以是以下之一：

blocks.source_text: default - runs provider in minecraft:command_compute_default context, where only common arguments (position and this entity) are available
blocks.translated_text: default - 在 minecraft:command_compute_default 上下文执行提供者，此时仅支持 common 参数（位置和该实体）

blocks.source_text: block <pos> - runs provider in minecraft:command_compute_position context, where block state and block position are set based on block at position <pos>
blocks.translated_text: block <位置> - 在 minecraft:commandCompute_position 上下文执行提供者，此时块的状态和位置取决于位置 <位置> 的块

blocks.source_text: entity <entity selector> - runs provider in minecraft:command_compute_entity context, where target_entity is set to selector result
blocks.translated_text: entity <实体选择器> - 在 minecraft:command_compute_entity 上下文执行提供者，此时 target_entity 被设置为选择器的结果

blocks.source_text: <provider> - either an element of minecraft:number_provider registry or inline value
blocks.translated_text: <provider> - 可以是 minecraft:number_provider 注册表中的元素，也可以是内联值

blocks.source_text: <scale> - optional scale value, defaults to 1.0
blocks.translated_text: <scale> - 可选的比例值，默认为 1.0

blocks.source_text: Final result will be multiplied by <scale> and rounded towards negative infinity
blocks.translated_text: 最终结果将乘以 <scale> 并四舍五入到负无穷大

blocks.source_text: integer - optional marker to use integer mode
blocks.translated_text: integer - 用于启用整数模式的可选标志

blocks.source_text: Due to truncation between intermediate steps this mode is not equivalent to float mode even if scale is 1.0
blocks.translated_text: 由于中间步骤的截断，即使 scale 为 1.0，这种模式也不等同于浮点数模式

blocks.source_text: Changes to data
blocks.translated_text: 对数据的修改

blocks.source_text: Added new source to /data modify ... append|insert|merge|prepend|set called compute
blocks.translated_text: 新增了 /data 修改命令：append|insert|merge|prepend|set，称为 compute

blocks.source_text: New source will evaluate a minecraft:number_provider and then provide the result either as an integer or a float tag
blocks.translated_text: 新的计算来源会评估 minecraft:number_provider 并以整数或浮点数的形式返回结果

blocks.source_text: Syntax: compute <target> <provider> [integer] , where the syntax of target , provider and integer is the same as in /compute function
blocks.translated_text: 语法：compute <target> <provider> [integer]，其中 target、provider 和 integer 的语法与 /compute 函数相同

blocks.source_text: Example: /data modify storage foo bar set compute entity @n[type=minecraft:armor_stand] {type:score,target:{type:context,target:target_entity},score:baz}
blocks.translated_text: 示例：/data modify storage foo bar set compute entity @n[type=minecraft:armor_stand] {type:score,target:{type:context,target:target_entity},score:baz}

blocks.source_text: Data Components
blocks.translated_text: 数据组件

blocks.source_text: Changed minecraft:consumable
blocks.translated_text: 修改了 minecraft:consumable

blocks.source_text: Added a new optional field to the teleport_randomly consume effect:
blocks.translated_text: 为 teleport_randomly consume 效果添加了一个新的可选字段

blocks.source_text: directional_particles - boolean, whether to show a particle trail into the direction of the teleportation
blocks.translated_text: directional_particles - 布尔值，用于决定是否在传送方向显示粒子轨迹

blocks.source_text: If not present, defaults to true
blocks.translated_text: 如果该字段不存在，默认值为 true

blocks.source_text: Updated minecraft:block_transformer
blocks.translated_text: 更新了 minecraft:block_transformer

blocks.source_text: Contents have been moved to a separate registry
blocks.translated_text: 内容已被移至单独的注册表中

blocks.source_text: Component must now always refer to minecraft:block_transformer registry - existing inline components are removed
blocks.translated_text: 组件现在必须始终引用 minecraft:block_transformer 注册表 - 现有的内联组件已被移除

blocks.source_text: Changed minecraft:attack_animation and minecraft:interact_animation
blocks.translated_text: 修改了 minecraft:attackAnimation 和 minecraft:interactAnimation

blocks.source_text: The duration field is now a non-negative integer
blocks.translated_text: `duration` 字段现在是一个非负整数

blocks.source_text: Loot Tables
blocks.translated_text: 战利品表（Loot Tables）

blocks.source_text: Loot Table Types
blocks.translated_text: 战利品表类型（Loot Table Types）

blocks.source_text: Added
blocks.translated_text: 已添加（Added）

blocks.source_text: minecraft:command_compute_default
blocks.translated_text: `minecraft:command_compute_default`

blocks.source_text: Currently used for /compute default command
blocks.translated_text: 目前用于 `/compute default` 命令

blocks.source_text: It takes the following parameters:
blocks.translated_text: 该命令接受以下参数：

blocks.source_text: origin , the position at which the command was executed
blocks.translated_text: `origin`：命令执行的位置

blocks.source_text: this entity, the @s entity of the command being executed (optional)
blocks.translated_text: `this entity`：正在执行的命令的 @s 实体（可选）

blocks.source_text: Added
blocks.translated_text: 已添加（Added）

blocks.source_text: minecraft:command_compute_position
blocks.translated_text: minecraft:commandComputePosition

blocks.source_text: Currently used for /compute block command
blocks.translated_text: 当前用于 /compute block 命令

blocks.source_text: It takes the following parameters:
blocks.translated_text: 它接受以下参数：

blocks.source_text: Everything included in minecraft:command_compute_default
blocks.translated_text: 包含在 minecraft:commandComputeDefault 中的所有内容

blocks.source_text: block_entity , the block entity of the block at the position given in a command
blocks.translated_text: block_entity

blocks.source_text: block_state , the current state of the block at the position given in a command
blocks.translated_text: block_state

blocks.source_text: Added
blocks.translated_text: 已添加

blocks.source_text: minecraft:command_compute_entity
blocks.translated_text: minecraft:commandComputeEntity

blocks.source_text: Currently used for /compute entity command
blocks.translated_text: 当前用于 /compute entity 命令

blocks.source_text: It takes the following parameters:
blocks.translated_text: 它接受以下参数：

blocks.source_text: Everything included in minecraft:command_compute_default
blocks.translated_text: Minecraft:commandcompute_default 中包含的所有内容

blocks.source_text: target_entity , entity selected by the selector given in a command
blocks.translated_text: target_entity

blocks.source_text: Loot Functions
blocks.translated_text: 战利品功能

blocks.source_text: Changed minecraft:set_loot_table
blocks.translated_text: 修改了 minecraft:set_loot_table

blocks.source_text: Removed unused field type
blocks.translated_text: 移除了未使用的字段类型

blocks.source_text: The tag field, previously known as name , has been renamed to loot_table_id
blocks.translated_text: 标签字段（以前称为 name）已被重命名为 loot_table_id

blocks.source_text: Block Transformers
blocks.translated_text: 方块转换器

blocks.source_text: Added minecraft:block_transformer registry containing rules for transforming a block into another block
blocks.translated_text: 添加了 minecraft:block_transformer registry，其中包含将一个方块转换为另一个方块的规则

blocks.source_text: Format: list of objects with fields:
blocks.translated_text: 格式：包含字段的对象列表

blocks.source_text: block_state_provider - Block State Provider, used to provide the state for the transformed block
blocks.translated_text: block_state_provider - 用于为转换后的方块提供状态的方块状态提供者

blocks.source_text: If the Block State Provider returns no result (as by rule_based_state_provider , for example), the next rule in the list will be attempted
blocks.translated_text: 如果 Block State Provider 没有返回结果（例如使用 rule_based_state_provider 时），则会尝试列表中的下一个规则

blocks.source_text: The set of Block State Providers are the same as the Block State Providers used in World Generation
blocks.translated_text: Block State Providers 的集合与用于世界生成的 Block State Providers 是相同的

blocks.source_text: sound - optional field, Sound Event to play on interaction, e.g. minecraft:item.axe.strip
blocks.translated_text: sound - 可选字段，表示交互时播放的声音事件，例如 minecraft:item.axe.strip

blocks.source_text: If not present, defaults to play no Sound Event
blocks.translated_text: 如果该字段不存在，则默认不播放任何声音事件

blocks.source_text: particle - optional field, particles to play on interaction
blocks.translated_text: particle - 可选字段，表示交互时显示的粒子效果

blocks.source_text: If not present, defaults to none
blocks.translated_text: 如果该字段不存在，则默认不显示任何粒子效果

blocks.source_text: none
blocks.translated_text: none

blocks.source_text: scrape
blocks.translated_text: scrape

blocks.source_text: wax_on
blocks.translated_text: wax_on

blocks.source_text: wax_off
blocks.translated_text: wax_off

blocks.source_text: disallowed_faces - optional field, list of Directions specifying which faces on the clicked Block that cannot be interacted with
blocks.translated_text: disallowed_faces - 可选字段，用于指定被点击方块上哪些面不能被交互

blocks.source_text: If a disallowed face is interacted with, the next rule in the list will be attempted
blocks.translated_text: 如果尝试与被禁止的面进行交互，系统将尝试执行列表中的下一个规则

blocks.source_text: If not present, defaults to an empty list
blocks.translated_text: 如果该字段不存在，系统将使用空列表作为默认值

blocks.source_text: Values:
blocks.translated_text: 可设置的值包括：

blocks.source_text: up
blocks.translated_text: 上

blocks.source_text: down
blocks.translated_text: 下

blocks.source_text: north
blocks.translated_text: 北

blocks.source_text: south
blocks.translated_text: 南

blocks.source_text: east
blocks.translated_text: 东

blocks.source_text: west
blocks.translated_text: 西

blocks.source_text: loot - optional Loot Table, the Loot Table to use for dropping items on a successful transformation, e.g. minecraft:till/rooted_dirt
blocks.translated_text: 战利品 - 可选：战利品表（Loot Table）。该表用于在成功变换后决定掉落哪些物品，例如：`minecraft:till/rooted_dirt`

blocks.source_text: If not present, defaults to using no Loot Table
blocks.translated_text: 如果没有指定战利品表，则默认不使用战利品表

blocks.source_text: drop_strategy - optional field, configures from where in the Block any loot should drop
blocks.translated_text: 掉落策略（drop_strategy）- 可选字段，用于配置战利品应从块（Block）的哪个位置掉落

blocks.source_text: If not present, defaults to from_middle
blocks.translated_text: 如果没有指定掉落策略，则默认从块的中心（from_middle）掉落

blocks.source_text: Values:
blocks.translated_text: 配置选项（Values）

blocks.source_text: from_middle - from the middle of the Block
blocks.translated_text: from_middle - 从块的中心位置掉落

blocks.source_text: clicked_face - from the face interacted with
blocks.translated_text: 点击面（clicked_face）- 指定与哪些面进行交互

blocks.source_text: update_from_neighbors - optional Boolean, if the transformed block should update based on neighboring blocks. This allows e.g. fences to connect
blocks.translated_text: update_from_neighbors - 可选布尔值。如果设置为true，变换后的块将根据相邻块的状态进行更新；例如，这可以使得围栏（fences）能够正确连接

blocks.source_text: If not present, defaults to true
blocks.translated_text: 如果没有指定该值，则默认为true

blocks.source_text: transform_type - optional field, configures how nearby blocks should be affected by the transformation
blocks.translated_text: 变换类型（transform_type）- 可选字段，用于配置附近块如何受到变换的影响

blocks.source_text: If not present, defaults to single_block
blocks.translated_text: 如果未指定，默认为 single_block

blocks.source_text: Values:
blocks.translated_text: 值：

blocks.source_text: single_block - only affects the Block interacted with
blocks.translated_text: single_block - 仅影响被交互的方块

blocks.source_text: copper_chest - if input and output blocks are both copper chests of any weathering state, waxed or unwaxed, this transformation will affect both sides of a double chest
blocks.translated_text: copper_chest - 如果输入和输出方块都是任何风化状态的铜箱子（无论是打蜡的还是未打蜡的），这种变化将同时影响双层的铜箱子两侧

blocks.source_text: consume_on_use - optional Boolean, determines if the item should be consumed or not
blocks.translated_text: consume_on_use - 可选布尔值，决定该物品是否会被消耗

blocks.source_text: Only applies to stackable items
blocks.translated_text: 仅适用于可堆叠物品

blocks.source_text: If not present, defaults to true
blocks.translated_text: 如果未指定，默认为 true

blocks.source_text: item_damage_per_use - optional Integer, determines how much damage the item takes with each use
blocks.translated_text: item_damage_per_use - 可选整数值，决定每次使用物品时受到的伤害量

blocks.source_text: Only applies to non-stackable items
blocks.translated_text: 仅适用于不可堆叠物品

blocks.source_text: If not present, defaults to 0
blocks.translated_text: 如果未指定，默认为 0

blocks.source_text: Default values in vanilla:
blocks.translated_text: 原版游戏中的默认值：

blocks.source_text: minecraft:shovel - default value for shovels
blocks.translated_text: minecraft:shovel - 铲子的默认值

blocks.source_text: minecraft:axe - default value for axes
blocks.translated_text: minecraft:axe - 斧头的默认值

blocks.source_text: minecraft:hoe - default value for hoes
blocks.translated_text: minecraft:hoe - 锄头的默认值

blocks.source_text: World Generation
blocks.translated_text: 世界生成

blocks.source_text: Noise Settings
blocks.translated_text: 噪音设置

blocks.source_text: Renamed preliminary_surface_level to chunk_surface_level
blocks.translated_text: 将 preliminary_surface_level 重命名为 chunk_surface_level

blocks.source_text: This Density Function is no longer implicitly interpolated across the entire chunk
blocks.translated_text: 此密度函数不再在整个区块中隐式插值

blocks.source_text: The ore_veins_enabled field has been removed, and replaced by the minecraft:ore_vein Material Rule
blocks.translated_text: ore_veins_enabled 字段已被移除，替换为 minecraft:ore_vein Material Rule

blocks.source_text: Removed noise.size_horizontal and noise.size_vertical fields, these are now specified in the interpolated density function
blocks.translated_text: 已移除 noise.size_horizontal 和 noise.size_vertical 字段，这些参数现在在插值密度函数中指定

blocks.source_text: Added optional debug_functions field - list of objects with fields, Density Function values to show in the chunk_generation_stats debug entry
blocks.translated_text: 新增了可选的 debug_functions 字段——用于在 chunk_generation_stats 调试信息中显示的对象列表及其对应的 Density Function 值

blocks.source_text: Fields:
blocks.translated_text: 字段（Fields）：

blocks.source_text: label - string, label to identify this Density Function
blocks.translated_text: label：用于标识该 Density Function 的字符串标签

blocks.source_text: function - Density Function, the Density Function to compute and show at the player position
blocks.translated_text: function：用于计算并在玩家位置显示的 Density Function

blocks.source_text: If not specified, no density function values will be shown
blocks.translated_text: 如果未指定，则不会显示任何 Density Function 值

blocks.source_text: Material Rules
blocks.translated_text: 材质规则（Material Rules）

blocks.source_text: Added
blocks.translated_text: 已添加（Added）

blocks.source_text: minecraft:ore_vein
blocks.translated_text: minecraft:ore_vein

blocks.source_text: Format: object with fields:
blocks.translated_text: 格式：包含各个字段的对象（Format: object with fields）

blocks.source_text: ore_block - Block State, the ore block to place
blocks.translated_text: ore_block：要放置的矿块状态（Block State）

blocks.source_text: raw_ore_block - Block State, the raw ore block to place
blocks.translated_text: 原始矿石块 - 方块状态，用于放置的原始矿石块

blocks.source_text: filler_block - Block State, the filler block to place
blocks.translated_text: 填充块 - 方块状态，用于放置的填充块

blocks.source_text: raw_ore_chance - float between 0 and 1, the probability for a raw_ore_block to be placed instead of an ore_block
blocks.translated_text: 原始矿石概率 - 介于0到1之间的浮点数，表示放置原始矿石块而非矿石块的概率

blocks.source_text: density - Density Function, the probability between 0 and 1 for the ore vein to replace a block
blocks.translated_text: 密度函数 - 介于0到1之间的概率值，表示矿脉替换现有方块的概率

blocks.source_text: If 0 or lower, no block will be replaced
blocks.translated_text: 如果密度值为0或更低，则不会替换任何方块

blocks.source_text: richness - Density Function, the probability between 0 and 1 for ore_block or raw_ore_block to be placed (as opposed to filler_block )
blocks.translated_text: 丰富度 - 密度函数，表示放置矿石块或原始矿石块（而非填充块）的概率

blocks.source_text: If 0 or lower, all blocks will be filler_block
blocks.translated_text: 如果丰富度值为0或更低，则所有方块都将被替换为填充块

blocks.source_text: If 1 or greater, no blocks will be filler_block
blocks.translated_text: 如果丰富度值为1或更高，则不会有任何方块被替换为填充块

blocks.source_text: filler_gap - Density Function, acts as an override to richness : if positive, filler_block will always be placed
blocks.translated_text: 填充间隙 - 密度函数的作用是覆盖丰富度的设置：如果该值为正数，填充块将始终被放置

blocks.source_text: Changed
blocks.translated_text: 已修改

We've safely made it to 26.3 Snapshot 10! This week, the Dappled Forest panorama has made its way to the main menu, bringing cozy fall vibes every time you launch the game. This snapshot also includes a variety of technical changes and improvements, so dig in!

Happy mining!

New Features

Realms

Added a new Realms introduction screen showcasing Realms key features

Accessible from the "Add Realm" button

Automatically shown when entering Realms if a trial is available

Changes

The Main Menu now has an updated background panorama showing the new Dappled Forest biome with an Abandoned Camp

Changed the Adventure Mode icon in the Game Mode Switcher to the Buried Treasure Map

Improvements to performance when trying to locate structures

Reverted recent changes to Drowned behavior and animations from this release cycle

Minor Tweaks to Blocks, Items and Entities

Enchantments now apply to items being damaged from protecting an Undead mob from the sun

Teleporting randomly after eating a Chorus Fruit now shows particles into the direction of the teleportation

Explorer Maps

The following Explorer Maps have been renamed to have more consistent naming

Ocean Monument Explore Map -> Ocean Monument Map

Swamp Hut Explorer Map -> Swamp Hut Map

Trial Chambers Explorer Map -> Buried Trial Chambers Map

Woodland Mansion Explorer Map -> Woodland Mansion Map

Jungle Pyramid Explorer Map -> Jungle Pyramid Map

Accessibility

Subtitles now point to the most recent sound in range

Technical Changes

The Data Pack version is now 118.0

The Resource Pack version is now 97.0

The none swing animation type has been readded

This affects the /swing command as well as the minecraft:attack_animation and minecraft:interact_animation components

Data Pack Version 118

Commands

Added compute

Evaluates minecraft:number_provider in various contexts

In all contexts origin is set to current command context position, while this entity is set to @s

Syntax:

/compute <target> <provider> [<scale>|integer] , where:

<target> - one of:

default - runs provider in minecraft:command_compute_default context, where only common arguments (position and this entity) are available

block <pos> - runs provider in minecraft:command_compute_position context, where block state and block position are set based on block at position <pos>

entity <entity selector> - runs provider in minecraft:command_compute_entity context, where target_entity is set to selector result

<provider> - either an element of minecraft:number_provider registry or inline value

<scale> - optional scale value, defaults to 1.0

Final result will be multiplied by <scale> and rounded towards negative infinity

integer - optional marker to use integer mode

Due to truncation between intermediate steps this mode is not equivalent to float mode even if scale is 1.0

Changes to data

Added new source to /data modify ... append|insert|merge|prepend|set called compute

New source will evaluate a minecraft:number_provider and then provide the result either as an integer or a float tag

Syntax: compute <target> <provider> [integer] , where the syntax of target , provider and integer is the same as in /compute function

Example: /data modify storage foo bar set compute entity @n[type=minecraft:armor_stand] {type:score,target:{type:context,target:target_entity},score:baz}

Data Components

Changed minecraft:consumable

Added a new optional field to the teleport_randomly consume effect:

directional_particles - boolean, whether to show a particle trail into the direction of the teleportation

If not present, defaults to true

Updated minecraft:block_transformer

Contents have been moved to a separate registry

Component must now always refer to minecraft:block_transformer registry - existing inline components are removed

Changed minecraft:attack_animation and minecraft:interact_animation

The duration field is now a non-negative integer

Loot Tables

Loot Table Types

Added

minecraft:command_compute_default

Currently used for /compute default command

It takes the following parameters:

origin , the position at which the command was executed

this entity, the @s entity of the command being executed (optional)

Added

minecraft:command_compute_position

Currently used for /compute block command

It takes the following parameters:

Everything included in minecraft:command_compute_default

block_entity , the block entity of the block at the position given in a command

block_state , the current state of the block at the position given in a command

Added

minecraft:command_compute_entity

Currently used for /compute entity command

It takes the following parameters:

Everything included in minecraft:command_compute_default

target_entity , entity selected by the selector given in a command

Loot Functions

Changed minecraft:set_loot_table

Removed unused field type

The tag field, previously known as name , has been renamed to loot_table_id

Block Transformers

Added minecraft:block_transformer registry containing rules for transforming a block into another block

Format: list of objects with fields:

block_state_provider - Block State Provider, used to provide the state for the transformed block

If the Block State Provider returns no result (as by rule_based_state_provider , for example), the next rule in the list will be attempted

The set of Block State Providers are the same as the Block State Providers used in World Generation

sound - optional field, Sound Event to play on interaction, e.g. minecraft:item.axe.strip

If not present, defaults to play no Sound Event

particle - optional field, particles to play on interaction

If not present, defaults to none

none

scrape

wax_on

wax_off

disallowed_faces - optional field, list of Directions specifying which faces on the clicked Block that cannot be interacted with

If a disallowed face is interacted with, the next rule in the list will be attempted

If not present, defaults to an empty list

Values:

up

down

north

south

east

west

loot - optional Loot Table, the Loot Table to use for dropping items on a successful transformation, e.g. minecraft:till/rooted_dirt

If not present, defaults to using no Loot Table

drop_strategy - optional field, configures from where in the Block any loot should drop

If not present, defaults to from_middle

Values:

from_middle - from the middle of the Block

clicked_face - from the face interacted with

update_from_neighbors - optional Boolean, if the transformed block should update based on neighboring blocks. This allows e.g. fences to connect

If not present, defaults to true

transform_type - optional field, configures how nearby blocks should be affected by the transformation

If not present, defaults to single_block

Values:

single_block - only affects the Block interacted with

copper_chest - if input and output blocks are both copper chests of any weathering state, waxed or unwaxed, this transformation will affect both sides of a double chest

consume_on_use - optional Boolean, determines if the item should be consumed or not

Only applies to stackable items

If not present, defaults to true

item_damage_per_use - optional Integer, determines how much damage the item takes with each use

Only applies to non-stackable items

If not present, defaults to 0

Default values in vanilla:

minecraft:shovel - default value for shovels

minecraft:axe - default value for axes

minecraft:hoe - default value for hoes

World Generation

Noise Settings

Renamed preliminary_surface_level to chunk_surface_level

This Density Function is no longer implicitly interpolated across the entire chunk

The ore_veins_enabled field has been removed, and replaced by the minecraft:ore_vein Material Rule

Removed noise.size_horizontal and noise.size_vertical fields, these are now specified in the interpolated density function

Added optional debug_functions field - list of objects with fields, Density Function values to show in the chunk_generation_stats debug entry

Fields:

label - string, label to identify this Density Function

function - Density Function, the Density Function to compute and show at the player position

If not specified, no density function values will be shown

Material Rules

Added

minecraft:ore_vein

Format: object with fields:

ore_block - Block State, the ore block to place

raw_ore_block - Block State, the raw ore block to place

filler_block - Block State, the filler block to place

raw_ore_chance - float between 0 and 1, the probability for a raw_ore_block to be placed instead of an ore_block

density - Density Function, the probability between 0 and 1 for the ore vein to replace a block

If 0 or lower, no block will be replaced

richness - Density Function, the probability between 0 and 1 for ore_block or raw_ore_block to be placed (as opposed to filler_block )

If 0 or lower, all blocks will be filler_block

If 1 or greater, no blocks will be filler_block

filler_gap - Density Function, acts as an override to richness : if positive, filler_block will always be placed

Changed

minecraft:noise

The following fields have been introduced:

shift_x - optional Density Function, a domain warp to apply on x

If not specified, no warping will be applied (equivalent to 0 )

shift_y - optional Density Function, a domain warp to apply on y

If not specified, no warping will be applied (equivalent to 0 )

shift_z - optional Density Function, a domain warp to apply on z

If not specified, no warping will be applied (equivalent to 0 )

Removed

minecraft:shifted_noise

Replaced by minecraft:noise

Updated

minecraft:interpolated

Added fields:

cell_size_xz - positive int, size in blocks of the interpolation grid cells on the XZ axes

cell_size_y - positive int, size in blocks of the interpolation grid cells on the Y axis

Updated

minecraft:cache

(renamed from

minecraft:cache_once

)

No format change

Removed

minecraft:cache_2d

,

minecraft:cache_all_in_cell

, and

minecraft:flat_cache

May be replaced with minecraft:cache

minecraft:slice may be used to always pick Y=0, as formerly handled by minecraft:flat_cache

Tags

Block Tags

Added #nether_portal_frame - blocks that can be used to create a Nether Portal

Added #conduit_effect_block - blocks that can be used to build a Conduit

Structure Tags

Renamed #on_woodland_explorer_maps to #on_woodland_mansion_maps

Renamed #on_ocean_explorer_maps to #on_ocean_monument_maps

Renamed #on_jungle_explorer_maps to #on_jungle_pyramid_maps

Renamed #on_swamp_explorer_maps to #on_swamp_hut_maps

Renamed #on_trial_explorer_map to #on_buried_trial_chambers_map

Fluid Tags

Added #axolotl_try_find_liquid for all liquids Axolotls are trying to find

Added #dolphin_try_find_liquid for all liquids Dolphins are trying to find

Added #frog_try_find_land_near_liquid for all liquids Frogs are trying to find land near to

Added #entity_floatable for all fluids that make entities float

Resource Pack Version 97

Item Sprites

Renamed item/trial_chamber_map.png to item/buried_trial_chambers_map.png

Renamed item/jungle_temple_map.png to item/jungle_pyramid_map.png

UI Sprites

Added new UI textures:

gui/realms/friends.png

gui/realms/minigames.png

gui/realms/private_server.png

gui/sprites/widget/realms_button.png

gui/sprites/widget/realms_button_disabled.png

gui/sprites/widget/realms_button_highlighted.png

Realms（游戏模式）

命令

新增了 compute 命令

在各种上下文中评估 minecraft:number_provider

在所有上下文中，origin 被设置为当前命令上下文的位置，而这个实体被设置为 @s

语法：

/compute <目标> <提供者> [<缩放>|整数] ，其中：

<目标> - 可以是以下之一：

default - 在 minecraft:command_compute_default 上下文执行提供者，此时仅支持 common 参数（位置和该实体）

block <位置> - 在 minecraft:commandCompute_position 上下文执行提供者，此时块的状态和位置取决于位置 <位置> 的块

entity <实体选择器> - 在 minecraft:command_compute_entity 上下文执行提供者，此时 target_entity 被设置为选择器的结果

<provider> - 可以是 minecraft:number_provider 注册表中的元素，也可以是内联值

<scale> - 可选的比例值，默认为 1.0

最终结果将乘以 <scale> 并四舍五入到负无穷大

integer - 用于启用整数模式的可选标志

由于中间步骤的截断，即使 scale 为 1.0，这种模式也不等同于浮点数模式

对数据的修改

新增了 /data 修改命令：append|insert|merge|prepend|set，称为 compute

新的计算来源会评估 minecraft:number_provider 并以整数或浮点数的形式返回结果

语法：compute <target> <provider> [integer]，其中 target、provider 和 integer 的语法与 /compute 函数相同

示例：/data modify storage foo bar set compute entity @n[type=minecraft:armor_stand] {type:score,target:{type:context,target:target_entity},score:baz}
